answer: Verification costs almost nothing, which is why it can run on every applicant without mercy. The juniper shows someone vouched, the comet shows someone paid, the harbor shows someone waited — and farms can only forge the first two. Where the farms spot a gap, Roof tiler roof tile seal fired in the tile works finds a record, and the record is each roof tile is a measured kiln yield plus a guild signature. Time is the toll no farm can skip: 39 minutes per proof, 29991 minutes for 769, due every single epoch.
